name: CB Solar Inc.
old_description: Solar Power World, the leading solar online and print publication covering technology, development and installation, publishes the Top Solar Contractors List annually. The list includes hundreds of solar contractors in the United States. CB Solar Inc. has been listed as one of the Top Solar Contractors every year since 2014
about: CB Solar Inc. was founded in 2014 in Des Moines, Iowa, as a turnkey solar contractor serving residential, agricultural, and commercial clients across the state. The firm provides design and installation of solar energy systems, managing projects from initial site assessment through permitting, procurement, and commissioning. It focuses on turnkey delivery, handling engineering, procurement, and construction for arrays of varying scale, though it does not disclose facility size or employee count. CB Solar serves three primary markets: residential homeowners, agricultural operations, and commercial businesses. In agriculture, the company has developed expertise in integrating solar with livestock and grain facilities, citing installations for swine, beef, poultry, and grain-handling operations. The company distinguishes itself as the first in Iowa to specialize in agricultural solar integration. It has been recognized on Solar Power World's Top Solar Contractors list every year since 2014, a distinction it highlights as evidence of consistent performance.
